termination: Verify all checkpoints, feature banks and evidence by complete SHA-256 storage readback before retiring the exact tagged experiment instances, volumes and security group. Protect the existing network hosts.
prerequisites: Both real-model feature arms pass all eight exact updates, original short-run selection remains all failed, and previous allocation is fully retired before provisioning.
selection: Both terminal1024 candidates must finish and be preserved; only eligible terminal candidates may open final questions after selection is committed.

recovery.required: Exact full checkpoint, weights, Adam, feature-bank root and development outputs after terminating the original tail and restoring onto a new instance.

quota_release_retry: At most 15 minutes, same idempotent request/client token, within allocation deadline; no extra ranks.
head_ownership: The tail stages a verified read-only tied embedding/output matrix and final norm in addition to owned trainable blocks. No worker holds the full parent.
accounting: Record feature production, training, evaluation, preservation and conditional recovery separately, with inclusive allocation costs; no claim that four owned EC2 machines are independent operators.
